name: Steady State Coffee Roasters
blocked: Closed-store price gate: Carlsbad location trades 7am-4pm and Google Maps confirms it is currently closed (opens 7AM Fri). Its Square ordering site (steady-state.square.site) marks every category - Espresso Based Drinks, Drip Coffee/Pour Overs/Cold Brew, Steady Kitchen, Indian Summer, Tasty Treats, Roasted Coffee, Teas, Steamed Mylks, Cold Fashioned, Tie-dye Tea, Fridge - as 'Available later' with no prices shown while closed. This is a drink-led coffee shop, so the drink list is the menu and it could not be read.
notes: The roaster's own site (steadystateroasting.com) does show priced bagged whole-bean coffee (Single Origins $18.50-$48.00, Blends $17.50-$20.00) which is real retail product data, but it is not the cafe's drink menu and recording it in place of the actual menu would misrepresent what this is as a venue. Left dishes empty; worth retrying during 7am-4pm trading hours.
